name: LOLIN D32
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) D32: 57 x 25.4 mm ESP32-WROOM-32 (4 MB flash) board with a CH340C USB bridge, micro-USB, and LiPo support: PH-2 (2.0 mm) battery connector plus a TP4054 charger (~500 mA max).
GPIO35 is not broken out - it is hardwired to an onboard 100k/100k divider on the battery: battery voltage = ADC reading x 2.
Blue onboard LED on GPIO5, active LOW (write LOW to light it). GPIO5 is also the default SPI SS and must be HIGH at boot.

Mind the two enable pads: RST (left side, near the top) resets the ESP32, while the pad silkscreened EN (left side, near the bottom) enables the 3.3 V regulator - pulling THAT low cuts power to the whole board.

No BOOT button, but the full auto-flash circuit (CH340C DTR/RTS) is present, so flashing needs no button presses. There is no regulated 5 V output: the USB pad is raw VBUS and the BAT pad is the battery terminal.

1.label: TX
1.note: UART0 TX, shared with the CH340C USB-serial bridge.

3.label: RX
3.note: UART0 RX, shared with the CH340C USB-serial bridge.

5.label: LED
5.note: Blue onboard LED, active LOW. Also the default SPI SS.
